#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage:
  scripts/install-skills.sh
  scripts/install-skills.sh --harness NAME[,NAME...] [--harness NAME...] [--yes]
  scripts/install-skills.sh --all [--yes]
  scripts/install-skills.sh [--harness NAME] [--yes] DEST
  scripts/install-skills.sh --list-harnesses

Copy every skill in skills/ into one or more harness skill directories. An
installed skill with the same name is replaced; other directories are left
untouched. Without a harness or destination, interactively select one or more
known harnesses by name.

  --harness NAME       Select a harness. Repeat the option or separate names
                       with commas. Known harnesses use their default paths.
  --all                Select every known harness.
  --list-harnesses     Show known harnesses and their default paths, then exit.
  --yes                Install without asking for final confirmation.
  DEST                 Override the destination for a single harness, or copy
                       without harness-specific configuration when no harness
                       is selected.
EOF
}

list_harnesses() {
  printf '%-10s %s\n' 'HARNESS' 'DEFAULT SKILLS DIRECTORY'
  printf '%-10s %s\n' 'codex' "$HOME/.agents/skills"
  printf '%-10s %s\n' 'cursor' "$HOME/.cursor/skills"
  printf '%-10s %s\n' 'claude' "$HOME/.claude/skills"
}

default_dest() {
  case "$1" in
    codex) printf '%s\n' "$HOME/.agents/skills" ;;
    cursor) printf '%s\n' "$HOME/.cursor/skills" ;;
    claude) printf '%s\n' "$HOME/.claude/skills" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

canonical_harness() {
  case "$1" in
    claude-code) printf '%s\n' 'claude' ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' "$1" ;;
  esac
}

add_harness() {
  local candidate existing
  candidate=$(canonical_harness "$1")
  if [[ ! "$candidate" =~ ^[a-z0-9-]+$ ]]; then
    printf 'Invalid harness name: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  for existing in "${harnesses[@]}"; do
    [[ "$existing" == "$candidate" ]] && return
  done
  harnesses+=("$candidate")
}

add_harness_list() {
  local value candidate
  value=${1//,/ }
  for candidate in $value; do
    add_harness "$candidate"
  done
}

add_all_harnesses() {
  add_harness codex
  add_harness cursor
  add_harness claude
}

# Print metadata.version from a SKILL.md frontmatter, or nothing.
skill_version() {
  [[ -f "$1" ]] || return 0
  awk '
    NR == 1 && /^---$/ { in_front = 1; next }
    in_front && /^---$/ { exit }
    in_front && /^[[:space:]]+version:/ {
      sub(/^[[:space:]]+version:[[:space:]]*/, ""); gsub(/"/, ""); print; exit
    }
  ' "$1"
}

preview_install() {
  local harness=$1 dest=$2 skill_dir name new_version old_version
  printf '\n%s -> %s\n' "${harness:-custom}" "$dest"
  for skill_dir in "${skill_dirs[@]}"; do
    name=$(basename -- "$skill_dir")
    new_version=$(skill_version "$skill_dir/SKILL.md")
    old_version=$(skill_version "$dest/$name/SKILL.md")
    if [[ ! -d "$dest/$name" ]]; then
      printf '  %s %s (new)\n' "$name" "${new_version:-?}"
    elif [[ "$old_version" != "$new_version" ]]; then
      printf '  %s %s -> %s\n' "$name" "${old_version:-?}" "${new_version:-?}"
    else
      printf '  %s %s\n' "$name" "${new_version:-?}"
    fi
  done
}

install_skills() {
  local harness=$1 dest=$2 skill_dir name core
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for skill_dir in "${skill_dirs[@]}"; do
    name=$(basename -- "$skill_dir")
    rm -rf -- "${dest:?}/$name"
    cp -R "${skill_dir%/}" "$dest/$name"
  done

  if [[ -n "$harness" ]]; then
    core="$dest/task/references/core.md"
    sed "s/^HARNESS:.*/HARNESS: $harness/" "$core" > "$core.tmp"
    mv "$core.tmp" "$core"
  fi
  printf 'Installed for %s -> %s\n' "${harness:-custom}" "$dest"
}

harnesses=()
dest=
assume_yes=false
select_all=false
show_harnesses=false

while (( $# > 0 )); do
  case "$1" in
    --harness)
      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { usage >&2; exit 2; }
      add_harness_list "$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --all) select_all=true; shift ;;
    --list-harnesses) show_harnesses=true; shift ;;
    --yes) assume_yes=true; shift ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    -*) usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *) [[ -z "$dest" ]] || { usage >&2; exit 2; }; dest=$1; shift ;;
  esac
done

if [[ "$show_harnesses" == true ]]; then
  list_harnesses
  exit 0
fi

[[ "$select_all" == false ]] || add_all_harnesses

if (( ${#harnesses[@]} == 0 )) && [[ -z "$dest" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -t 0 ]]; then
    printf 'No harness selected. Use --harness, --all, or run interactively.\n' >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  printf 'Available harnesses:\n'
  list_harnesses
  printf '\nSelect one or more by name (space/comma-separated, or "all"): '
  read -r selection || selection=
  if [[ "$selection" == all ]]; then
    add_all_harnesses
  else
    add_harness_list "$selection"
  fi
  if (( ${#harnesses[@]} == 0 )); then
    printf 'No harness selected; nothing was changed.\n'
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [[ -n "$dest" ]] && (( ${#harnesses[@]} > 1 )); then
  printf 'DEST can only be used with a single harness.\n' >&2
  exit 2
fi

destinations=()
if (( ${#harnesses[@]} == 0 )); then
  destinations+=("$dest")
else
  for harness in "${harnesses[@]}"; do
    if [[ -n "$dest" ]]; then
      destinations+=("$dest")
    elif harness_dest=$(default_dest "$harness"); then
      destinations+=("$harness_dest")
    else
      printf 'Harness %s has no default destination; provide DEST.\n' "$harness" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
  done
fi

source_root="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../skills" && pwd)"
skill_dirs=("$source_root"/*/)

if (( ${#harnesses[@]} == 0 )); then
  preview_install '' "${destinations[0]}"
else
  for index in "${!harnesses[@]}"; do
    preview_install "${harnesses[$index]}" "${destinations[$index]}"
  done
fi

if [[ "$assume_yes" == false ]]; then
  printf '\nInstall these skills? [y/N] '
  read -r answer || answer=
  if [[ "$answer" != [yY] ]]; then
    printf 'Cancelled; nothing was changed.\n'
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if (( ${#harnesses[@]} == 0 )); then
  install_skills '' "${destinations[0]}"
else
  for index in "${!harnesses[@]}"; do
    install_skills "${harnesses[$index]}" "${destinations[$index]}"
  done

import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

class InstallationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def install(self, destination, harness=None):
        args = ["bash", str(ROOT / "scripts/install-skills.sh"), "--yes"]
        if harness:
            args += ["--harness", harness]
        subprocess.run(args + [str(destination)], check=True, capture_output=True)

    def test_named_harness_bytes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            for harness in ("codex", "claude", "cursor"):
                with self.subTest(harness=harness):
                    dest = Path(tmp) / harness
                    self.install(dest, harness)
                    for source in (ROOT / "skills").rglob("*"):
                        if source.is_file():
                            self.assertEqual(source.read_bytes(), (dest / source.relative_to(ROOT / "skills")).read_bytes())

    def test_custom_destination_bytes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            dest = Path(tmp)
            self.install(dest)
            source = ROOT / "skills/task/references/core.md"
            self.assertEqual(source.read_bytes(), (dest / "task/references/core.md").read_bytes())

    def test_replacement_and_unrelated_directory(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            dest = Path(tmp)
            self.install(dest, "codex")
            stale = dest / "task/stale.txt"
            stale.write_text("obsolete")
            keep = dest / "unrelated/keep.txt"
            keep.parent.mkdir()
            keep.write_text("keep")
            self.install(dest, "codex")
            self.assertFalse(stale.exists())
            self.assertEqual(keep.read_text(), "keep")

    def test_explicit_source_override_is_preserved(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            source_root = Path(tmp) / "project"
            import shutil
            shutil.copytree(ROOT / "skills", source_root / "skills")
            shutil.copytree(ROOT / "scripts", source_root / "scripts")
            source = source_root / "skills/task/references/core.md"
            source.write_text("HARNESS: custom-agent\n")
            dest = Path(tmp) / "installed"
            subprocess.run(["bash", str(source_root / "scripts/install-skills.sh"), "--yes", "--harness", "codex", str(dest)], check=True, capture_output=True)
            self.assertEqual(source.read_bytes(), (dest / "task/references/core.md").read_bytes())
